title: A viral Reddit post by a purported developer alleging that a "major food delivery app" exploits drivers appears AI-generated; Uber and DoorDash deny the claims (Elissa Welle/The Verge)
summary: Elissa Welle / The Verge: A viral Reddit post by a purported developer alleging that a “major food delivery app” exploits drivers appears AI-generated; Uber and DoorDash deny the claims — It might be AI-generated, but food delivery apps do have a track record of exploiting workers.
